boundedNextDiagnosticProposal.scope: Only these exact retained literal URLs on each existing binding’s allowed host. No user-supplied arbitrary URL, registration/market edit, LLM, model document charge or source-check credit.
boundedNextDiagnosticProposal.runtimeRequirement: Wait for the current normal collector to complete; restore its latest verified archive. Re-fetch root/feed and collect the missing literal next page/current item bodies under one shared lease, retain actual response/redirect/status/time/body digests. All attempts remain charged.
boundedNextDiagnosticProposal.futureFeedExpansion: Any further page/item must be literally advertised by captured qualified structure, stay within the same allowed host and evidenced item/page rules, and fit a small reviewed cap. Unknown controls, extra hosts or required missing pages stop incomplete.

adapterAcceptanceProposal.status: Must be reviewed and implemented separately after missing actual proof; no activation authorized here.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.itemRule: Require exactly the publisher’s wd_item_list/wd_item cards, wd_title link and nonempty wd_date. Official dated article paths must agree with parsed publisher dates. Keep index URLs, page controls and article URLs separate; reject navigation or unrelated products.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.rssRule: Require exact publisher/channel identity, safe unique link==guid, nonempty titles and parseable zoned pubDate; preserve publication dates for item scheduling. Feed items must match the HTML index prefix in URL/date/order. Never use sitemap lastmod as event date.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.pagingRule: Only captured /news-releases and exact disclosed ?o=N controls; validate step/active page/next agreement, stable highest advertised page, nonincreasing release dates across actual pages, dedup/no loops, same host, and bounded missing/unsafe/page-cap failures. Missing next page currently prevents qualification.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.windowRule: Current 30-day source completeness needs actual ordered index/feed evidence reaching before Sep24. The existing first page and five feed items bracket this window, but ordering/retention and next-page proof must be qualified explicitly. Use conservative full traversal unless an independently reviewed ordered-window boundary is proved by the retained actual responses. Preserve every previously pending/historical audit item separately; do not narrow the source promise to make a task green.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.quietRule: A complete proved traversal with recognized dated releases entirely older than the current window may be quiet. Empty, changed, ambiguous, undated, mixed-issuer or JavaScript-only layouts stay incomplete.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.positiveRule: The two currently eligible release bodies must be actually captured and issuer/publication/date-joined before positive collection proof. Fact extraction/review remains independent.
adapterAcceptanceProposal.delineaSonatypeRule: Do not implement or activate a feed from an advertised URL alone. First obtain actual RSS bodies, issuer/path/date/item-count/retention/next evidence; then draft their exact bounded modes.

historicalPendingAnalysis.boundary: No global model/document allowance exhaustion occurred in these task receipts. Per-source maxDocumentsPerSource=2 and maxAuditDocumentsPerSource=1 bound selection. Broad inventories and item-level empty-review/redirect failures keep tasks incomplete. Lastmod is only scheduling metadata. selection.py:59 also returns all inventory minus selected, including three already-audited non-selected entries; that is not merely due work remaining. Preserve all old inventory and audit obligations while reviewing this selection contract; do not drop it to obtain coverage.
